name: fleet_haiku_contrarian_turnarounds
strategy: AI-monetizing SaaS recovery (CRM) with direct crypto exposure (BTC/ETH) and bitcoin treasury proxy (MSTR), plus beaten-down security SaaS (OKTA)
reassessment_note: ADBE contrarian recovery thesis has definitively failed—Adobe's stock continues structural decline (-13.73% on leg, -27.6% YTD) driven by irreversible AI generative tool commoditization of creative work. Unlike ADBE, CRM has successfully converted AI threat to monetization opportunity (Agentforce +114% YoY ARR, +18.69% on leg) and remains the valid contrarian SaaS play. MSTR (+62.96%) has emerged as the clear market winner via bitcoin treasury strategy with analyst targets at $231. Repositioning to concentrate on proven AI monetizers, add MSTR as bitcoin hedge and high-conviction position, add OKTA as beaten-down security SaaS with AI-agent upside, and exit ADBE entirely. Thesis pivots from 'AI-disruption recovery' to 'AI-monetizer selection' within contrarian SaaS opportunity.

positions.thesis: MicroStrategy has built 845,050 BTC treasury (~4% of total supply), making it world's largest bitcoin treasury on public market. Stock up 62.96% on leg as traders recognize it as leveraged bitcoin play with analyst consensus Buy at avg $231 target. Bitcoin bull thesis supports both direct crypto and MSTR positioning as macro tailwind persists.

Salesforce successfully monetizing AI threat via Agentforce platform generating $1.4B ARR (+114% YoY). Unlike ADBE, CRM converts AI from threat to growth catalyst. Analyst consensus Buy with $281.08 target (+20.11% upside). Up 18.69% on leg validates contrarian thesis. Core CRM use case is durable and expanding with AI augmentation.

Bitcoin up 31.74% YTD amid risk-on sentiment and Fed rate hiking cycle. Slight pullback from $84,034.92 mark to mid-$76k range creates entry opportunity. Complementary to MSTR treasury play and macro positioning for inflation persistence. AI capital spending boom and geopolitical tensions support continued risk-on stance and commodities bid.

Block Inc (SQ) holds $600M+ in bitcoin, making it crypto fintech exposure with embedded tail upside. Trading at attractive valuation with focus on profitability. Cash App Borrow originations up 134%, expanding consumer credit addressable market. Fintech macro headwinds persist but crypto treasury asset provides asymmetric upside if bitcoin bull thesis extends.

Ethereum up 31.51% YTD in line with Bitcoin momentum. Smart contract platform exposure to AI application development and DeFi growth themes. Slight pullback from $2,690.48 mark provides entry point. Maintains diversification within crypto exposure vs pure Bitcoin positioning while riding same bull narrative.

Okta beaten down but recent 28% bounce signals recovery interest as AI-agent security features attract analyst coverage and enterprise adoption accelerates. Identity and access management increasingly critical as AI agents proliferate in enterprise. Well below 2021 peaks but positioned for recovery as market reprices security SaaS beneficiary of AI revolution.
